title: The Unstoppable Power of Pangong Lake

scenes.label: HIGH ALTITUDE
scenes.text: Pangong Lake is situated at an altitude of over 4300 meters

scenes.label: SALINE WATER
scenes.text: Pangong Lake is a saline water lake with no outlet

scenes.label: BORDER DISPUTE
scenes.text: Pangong Lake is a disputed territory between India and China
